title: SC strikes down portions of Magna Carta of seafarers
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The Supreme Court has struck down as unconstitutional the provisions of the Magna Carta of Filipino Seafarers requiring workers to post a bond pending resolution of labor cases,…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Supreme Court has struck down as unconstitutional the provisions of the Magna Carta of Filipino Seafarers requiring workers to post a bond pending resolution of labor cases, as well as restricting legal remedies, as these violate due process.
